'''Werrjuice''' was a powerful narcotic. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], stories persisted that an [[SE4 servant droid]] in the service of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] fed werrjuice to a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. The droid in question had previously served a notorious [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="RASB" />
